title: FAIR-IRS: code, notebooks and results for "Who Gets Suspected, and Who Gets Away? Burden and Evasion in History-Dependent Insider-Risk Alerting"
description: Code, Colab notebooks, result files and extended results for a study of false-alert burden and insider evasion in history-dependent insider-risk alerting (cooldowns, similarity scheduling, parity rules with memory, private burden reports), evaluated on the synthetic CERT Insider Threat Test Dataset (r4.2, r5.2, r6.2). The CERT data are not redistributed.
